theme: 3 terms on generics in depth: a new name for a type that still takes a type parameter, an extension that applies only under a condition, and a subscript whose caller picks the type

terms.definition: A `typealias` with its own type parameter, like `Pair<T>`, that gives a generic type a shorter name.
terms.example: Add a Generic Typealias, so we stop writing the full dictionary type everywhere.

terms.definition: An extension with a `where` clause, so its methods exist only when the type meets that condition.
terms.example: Put `total` in a Constrained Extension, so only arrays of `Int` get it.

terms.definition: A subscript with its own type parameter, so the caller decides which type comes back.
terms.example: With a Generic Subscript, one lookup returns an `Int` or a `String`.

video.description:
Learn to explain generics in depth: Generic Typealias, Constrained Extension & Generic Subscript, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Generic Typealias - A `typealias` with its own type parameter, like `Pair<T>`, that gives a generic type a shorter name.
Constrained Extension - An extension with a `where` clause, so its methods exist only when the type meets that condition.
Generic Subscript - A subscript with its own type parameter, so the caller decides which type comes back.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: Swift Generic Typealias, Constrained Extension & Generic Subscript | Day 65
landscape.description:
Explain Generic Typealias, Constrained Extension & Generic Subscript in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
제네릭 타입 별칭, 제약 있는 익스텐션, 제네릭 서브스크립트 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Generic Typealias - A `typealias` with its own type parameter, like `Pair<T>`, that gives a generic type a shorter name.
한국어: 제네릭 타입 별칭: `Pair<T>`처럼 타입 매개변수를 가진 `typealias`로, 제네릭 타입에 짧은 이름을 붙임

Constrained Extension - An extension with a `where` clause, so its methods exist only when the type meets that condition.
한국어: 제약 있는 익스텐션: `where` 절이 붙어서 타입이 조건을 만족할 때만 메서드가 생기는 익스텐션

Generic Subscript - A subscript with its own type parameter, so the caller decides which type comes back.
한국어: 제네릭 서브스크립트: 자기만의 타입 매개변수를 가져서 호출하는 쪽이 돌려받을 타입을 정하는 서브스크립트

In this video, Mina and Jake read a settings store: a type name that is only an alias, a property that exists only for numbers and a lookup that returns whatever type you ask for, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain these three generics tricks in English?

dialogue.title: Where is Table defined?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, what's `Table`? I can't find that type.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's a Generic Typealias. `Table<Int>` is just a dictionary from `String` to `Int`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Shorter to write, same type underneath?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. A Generic Typealias only gives the type a new name.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's a Constrained Extension. `total` only exists for tables of `Int`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. The Constrained Extension adds it only when the condition is true.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And why does the subscript in `Settings` have angle brackets?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's a Generic Subscript. The caller picks the type it wants back.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. A Generic Subscript returns an `Int` or a `String` from the same `raw`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can't find the `Table` type anywhere.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's a Generic Typealias for a dictionary.
